description: This file is a header file (.h) that declares external function prototypes and includes licensing information related to the BREE Site Resource Manager (BMW 2.0). It provides function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the BREE SRM object, which are used across different C source files within the BREE component.

methods.name: BreeCreateSrmo
methods.description: Function to create a Site Resource Manager object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: BreeSrmoCreate
methods.description: Function to instantiate a SRM object with given context handles.

methods.name: BreeSrmoRemove
methods.description: Function to remove and clean up a SRM object identified by handle.

methods.name: BreeSrmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Function to enroll necessary objects within the SRM object.

methods.name: BreeSrmoInitialize
methods.description: Function to initialize the SRM object.
